title: discladium squarrosum
intro: Discladium squarrosum, commonly known as Thai starfruit or Pak Khrong, is a tropical plant species native to Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Discladium squarrosum include its potential to lower blood sugar levels, improve digestion, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Discladium squarrosum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
